items.markdown:
![10 things to do in Chiang Mai you can't miss in 2026](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07262227-1672-0139-0000-d00aae2e8eaf:4)
Top things to do in Chiang Mai include `visiting sacred mountain temples, exploring vibrant night markets, and experiencing ethical wildlife sanctuaries`.[](https://www.geekyexplorer.com/things-to-do-in-chiang-mai/) [[1]](https://www.geekyexplorer.com/things-to-do-in-chiang-mai/)[[2]](https://bornglobals.com/en/2018/08/things-to-do-in-chiang-mai-thailand/)

Temples and Culture

- **Wat Phra That Doi Suthep** : A stunning 13th-century golden temple perched on a mountain overlooking the city. Reach it by climbing over 300 steps or via a rideshare.
- **Wat Chedi Luang** : Located in the middle of the Old Town, featuring a massive, partially ruined ancient pagoda.
- **Wat Pha Lat** : A peaceful jungle temple that you can visit by hiking a quiet path called the Monk’s Trail.[](https://www.geekyexplorer.com/things-to-do-in-chiang-mai/) [[1]](https://www.travellikeanna.com/expats-guide-to-chiang-mai/)[[2]](https://www.lonelyplanet.com/articles/top-things-to-do-in-chiang-mai)

Food and Markets

- **Khao Soi** : Eat a bowl of this famous local northern Thai coconut curry noodle soup.
- **Sunday Night Market** : Walk down Rachadamnoen Road starting from Tha Phae Gate to shop for crafts and eat street food.
- **Warorot Market** : Explore this huge, bustling daytime market near the river for local snacks and dried fruits.[](https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/Attractions-g293917-Activities-Chiang_Mai.html) [[1]](https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/Attractions-g293917-Activities-Chiang_Mai.html)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R6f0IDBE4-k)[[3]](https://kelseyinlondon.com/best-things-to-do-in-chiang-mai/)[[4]](https://www.wheregoesrose.com/fun-unique-things-to-do-chiang-mai/)

Nature and Adventure

- **Ethical Elephant Sanctuaries** : Spend a half-day or full day observing and feeding rescued elephants at reputable sites like Elephant Nature Park.[](https://www.geekyexplorer.com/things-to-do-in-chiang-mai/) 
- **Doi Inthanon National Park** : Take a day trip about 1.5 hours outside the city to see Thailand's highest peak, waterfalls, and nature trails.[](https://www.geekyexplorer.com/things-to-do-in-chiang-mai/) [[1]](https://inbetweentravels.com/chiang-mai-travel-guide-the-best-things-to-do/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8iEnjJjVzag&t=686)
- **Bua Tong Sticky Waterfalls** : Visit the limestone waterfall where the grippy rock surface lets you climb straight up the cascading water.[](https://inbetweentravels.com/chiang-mai-travel-guide-the-best-things-to-do/)
